selection_reasoning: The player must first craft stone slabs from stone materials, then use those crafted stone slabs to build a pillar. This creates a natural production-to-construction dependency chain. Crafting stone slabs requires interacting with a crafting table and having smooth stone or stone in inventory, and building a pillar requires stacking blocks vertically. Both tasks are easily observable and verifiable — crafting is checked via inventory, and pillar building is checked via placed blocks in the world. The chain avoids deep Minecraft domain knowledge while maintaining a meaningful multi-hop dependency.

edges.reason: Building a pillar requires stone slabs as building material, which must first be crafted at the crafting table

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafted stone_slab ends up in the player's inventory and the player starts with zero stone slabs. One craft of 3 stone produces 6 stone slabs, so min_count=6 confirms at least one successful crafting operation at the crafting table.

Uses count_in_box_at_least(kind=block) because building a pillar means placing blocks vertically in the world. The box covers the entire 17x17 platform horizontally (±8 blocks from spawn on X and Z) and spans Y=0 to Y=+5 spawn-relative (the cleared building space above the platform surface). min_count=3 requires at least 3 stone_slab blocks placed in this volume, confirming a vertical pillar structure. Both individual slabs and double slabs share the block ID 'stone_slab', so all placement styles are detected. With 6 slabs from one craft, even worst-case double-slab merging yields 3 block positions.

scene_description: A large flat 17x17 smooth stone platform cleared of all obstructions, with a crafting table placed at ~3 ~0 ~3. The player spawns at the center with 12 stone and 6 smooth_stone in their inventory. The player must first use the crafting table to craft stone slabs (3 stone → 6 stone slabs), then use those slabs to build a vertical pillar by stacking them. The open platform provides ample space for pillar construction and clear line of sight to the crafting table.
task_text: First, walk to the crafting table and craft stone slabs from the stone in your inventory. Then, use the crafted stone slabs to build a pillar by stacking them vertically on the ground.
design_notes: The platform is 17x17 smooth_stone at y-1 relative to spawn, with air cleared above to y+8. The crafting table is 3 blocks east and 3 blocks south of spawn, easily visible and reachable. Player receives 12 stone (enough to craft 24 stone slabs via 3 stone → 6 slabs recipe) and 6 smooth_stone as extra material. The stone slab crafting recipe requires placing 3 stone blocks in a horizontal row in the crafting table. After crafting, the player places slabs vertically to form a pillar. The open platform ensures no obstructions for building. Pillar detection should check for 3+ vertically stacked stone_slab blocks anywhere on the platform.
